profile.headline: IT Manager/Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Results-driven IT leader with 3+ years of experience building and scaling IT operations in a growing organization. Successfully expanded the IT department from a single contributor to a high-performing multi-team department while serving in an IT Manager capacity.
 
Led the evaluation, selection, and enterprise-wide implementation of an ERP system, transitioning the organization from fragmented, homegrown tools to a fully integrated platform. Directed cross-functional initiatives to standardize business processes and align operations within the new ERP framework.
 
Strengthened IT infrastructure and security posture across multiple locations by designing and implementing network architecture, including for a newly constructed facility, and managing a unified network across three sites. Oversaw device lifecycle management (procurement, configuration, deployment) and negotiated vendor and ISP contracts to optimize cost and performance.
 
Drove operational efficiency through technology by deploying a cloud-based phone system (Nextiva), implementing EDI automation for a significant portion of the order pipeline, and delivering custom Python and SQL-based solutions to support data-driven decision-making across departments.
 
Proven leader in team development, hiring, and management across IT and Information Systems functions, with a strong focus on process improvement, system integration, and business enablement.

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description:
- Built and scaled IT department from 1 to a multi-team department, establishing structure, roles, and operational processes
- Served in IT Manager capacity, overseeing day-to-day IT operations and strategic technology initiatives
- Led evaluation, selection, and implementation of enterprise ERP system, transitioning from homegrown tools to a fully integrated platform
- Directed cross-functional efforts to document, standardize, and align business processes within the ERP environment
- Designed and implemented network infrastructure for a newly constructed facility, ensuring scalability and reliability
- Managed and maintained a unified network across three physical locations
- Improved IT security posture and infrastructure through system upgrades, policy improvements, and centralized management
- Oversaw procurement, configuration, and deployment of end-user devices across the organization
- Negotiated and managed ISP and vendor contracts to optimize cost and service levels
- Deployed and administered cloud-based phone system (Nextiva), improving communication capabilities
- Led implementation of EDI automation, significantly increasing efficiency in the order processing pipeline
- Developed custom Python scripts and SQL queries to support reporting, automation, and operational decision-making across departments
- Hired, trained, and managed IT and Information Systems personnel, building a high-performing team

positions.title: Software Engineer (Support)
positions.description:
As an Enterprise Software Support Engineer, I provided real-time troubleshooting for customer product issues, trained customers on how to use product and resolve issues, solved issues by changing frontend/backend configuration in their environment.

In addition to live customer support, I regularly created and ran scripts on customer databases and managed server configurations.
positions.insights: Skills: Remote Troubleshooting · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Javascript Developer
positions.description:
At Ocore/Indevity, I filled a core development role that included developed critical functionalities of the application, responded to critical errors, and reviewed code.

My developmental responsibilities involved creating the dashboard and reporting functionalities in JavaScript/Meteor and implementing data visualization for customizable fields.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · JavaScript · MongoDB · Meteor.js · Node.js

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
As project manager at BYU Office of Information Technology, I managed client relations and customized project deliverables and timelines to maintain product quality as per client requirements. I also configured and prepared AV devices for in-classroom use and provided troubleshooting for new software.

Key Achievements:
- Deployed new AV systems campus wide in order to host online classes
- Optimized financial tracking/documentation procedures
- Enhanced internal close-out report processes
- Deployed new interfaces to hundreds of devices across campus
- Configured 500+ new systems in a two-week span

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: As an Application Developer, I learned and applied principles of SAP and ABAP development by developing data tracking functionalities for BNSF's Mechanical Asset Management (MAM) system. This feature managed the tracking, replacing, inspecting and servicing of all mechanical parts of a locomotive according to safety standards and part lifespans.
positions.insights: Skills: Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP) · SAP

positions.title: Special Projects Clerk
positions.description:
As Special Projects Clerk at Domina Law, I organized and prepared important legal documents for trial, produced procedure manuals, and provided IT support for the entire firm.

Key achievement:
- Researched, developed, and implemented new document protection procedures that protected the firm against major breaches in thousands of client documents.
- Optimized firm archives organization
